bars.says: A traveller crosses open hard dirty-white ice with geological ridges and ice crystals under cold overhead light, without an interior wind, snowfall, liquid pools, soil or a native surface glow.

meant.intent: Land: this must be the still impure upland, distinguishable from a blue ice basin, a snowfield and a farmable arctic map.
meant.source: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/sleeping_ice.md §§1–3,5–6,4c.7, owner-ratified 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-24; delegated composition of those land rulings.

accept: A traveller walks between dirty-white slabs, frost crystals and a low ridge; the sky lights their upper edges while the ground remains bare hard ice.
A local artificial lamp warms the colour beside the camp; the distant interior remains under cold sky light.
reject: The biome has the right name and weather table, but the colony stands on a blue snowy plain containing a prefab puddle and a fertile patch.
The only dirty-white view is a camera fixture while ordinary ticking brings interior wind or snowfall.
bars.lazy: The biome has the right name and weather table, but the colony stands on a blue snowy plain containing a prefab puddle and a fertile patch.

range.varies: Full 200, 250 and 300 cell square supported colony maps; flat, small/large-hill and mountainous local terrain, open/interior/camp and prefab footprints, interior versus identifiable escarpment; coldest and warmest saved upland positions, ordinary aurora active/inactive; fresh arrival and days 7,15,100. View at routine play zoom and close inspection. These are local-map fixtures on the fixed planet, not generated planets.
range.left_out: Unrestricted dev placement of foreign soil/water and foreign biome replacement are unsupported; own generators, injected prefabs and enabled shared-engine defaults are included. Margin event mechanics are deferred, never substituted across the interior.

sees.instrument: Cheapest complete instrument: terrain/room census and direct weather-override, run-lock and sky-scheduler state reads, plus a live visual/audio look at ordinary full-map samples (T3). State-only absence probes precede the look.
sees.start: An ordinary SleepingIce local map, not repainted proof strips; natural weather scheduler and fixed tile geometry running; no debug lighting override.
sees.on: Every kept SleepingIce mechanic at shipped defaults, CreatureBehaviors swim/tells/confinement, Wreckage field/salvage, EnvironmentalHazards, ExplosiveGrowth and Bones enabled; all DLC; no research, timer, weather or AI locks; next-version extras off. Campaign checks also load the existing canon visitor patches and ordinary WeatherSuite; no biome-specific sun override.
sees.control: Read actual terrain at the viewed cells and distant quadrants after ordinary ticking to exclude a white overlay or cropped puddle-free view. Read the weather decider's actual forced/dev override state and the run's own weather/sky/lighting lock record throughout the observation, including after reload. Read the resolved sky geometry, scheduler eligibility and ticking, and active game-condition identities with their ordinary creation provenance. Natural Clear-only weather is valid, but its history cannot establish absence of a Clear lock. A planted Clear lock must invalidate the reading even when its weather history matches the unlocked control. If any required lock or scheduler read is unavailable, report UNMEASURED.
sees.reset: Use a disposable fixture save; after reading discard the branch and reload its untouched start, including map state, settings, random state, teaching flags and clock. Never modify the canonical world.
sees.live_only_why: Rendered light, silhouette, moving marks and audible spatial cues can be present as state yet unusable to a player. State exports cannot decide this perceptual distinction.

bars.says: A colony on the ice must bring food and feed its livestock, while its admitted visitors and stationary mineable life remain distinct from a self-sustaining surface herd or garden.

meant.intent: Life: emptiness is ecological, not missing content; ordinary milk and cargo roles work, and a catalytic ridge never starts behaving as a creature.
meant.source: sleeping_ice.md §§4,6–7 and closed cast §4c; rosters/sleeping_ice.json visitor law; bedazzle review §8 hessarund only a landform; delegated first-version life boundary.

accept: A supplied zhissa gives milk and an imported tellurox carries cargo; outside their shelter the player finds no pasture or foraging crop, and mining a hessarund yields its crust.
A wandering visitor is injured by the cold or leaves normally with a readable account; no resident arctic food herd replaces it.
reject: The animal defs resolve, but the player can live on renewing wild pasture, or the shell pack beast cannot carry a caravan load.
A stationary ridge starts chasing a miner, or a cold casualty disappears to imply an unbuilt rescue below.
bars.lazy: The animal defs resolve, but the player can live on renewing wild pasture, or the shell pack beast cannot carry a caravan load.

range.varies: Both franchise-free and campaign-patched Biomes loads, with all DLC in each; admitted patch visitors individually and ordinary spawner population together; 1–6 traveller pawns and 40 colonists, fed/unfed imported livestock, birth, milking, caravan loading, casualty and ordinary departure; days 1–15 and day100 snapshot. All current roster memberships retained. No demand that every random map rolls every scarce visitor.
range.left_out: No new wild admission for tellurox and no restoration of historically evicted donor residents; named deferred special organisms retain admission but their encounter systems are next-version content. Foreign farming cheats excluded; own soil/crop or growth-engine leaks included.

bars.says: A party stopping on the ice can recover usable preserved material from frozen wrecks and mineable ridges, then carry it onward without unlocking a separate progression system.

meant.intent: Land and life: preserved debris and the behaviourless living ridge make a chosen stop useful using ordinary salvage and mining.
meant.source: sleeping_ice.md §§7–8; bedazzle §8 hessarund catalyst yield; src/RimMandrake/SleepingIce/Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/RM_NightsideWrecks.xml; delegated payoff inferred from owner-chosen crossing/digging experience, 2026-10-20.

accept: A party deconstructs a frost-locked hull, mines the ridge, loads the resulting useful material and continues its journey.
Later arrivals still find unworked preserved objects where they were left; harvested ground stays worked.
reject: Pretty wrecks can be selected but an ordinary salvage job produces no usable haul, or the ridge has a mining order with no recoverable material.
Useful salvage appears only as a recurring free delivery, or depends on a new rite, tablet or research unlock.
bars.lazy: Pretty wrecks can be selected but an ordinary salvage job produces no usable haul, or the ridge has a mining order with no recoverable material.

range.varies: All hull/tank/rig families, accessible and initially obstructed placements, cluster and isolated layouts, player skill 0–20 as regression input not a reward bar; ridge edge/interior mining, ordinary hauling/storage/full inventory, caravan capacity empty/full; fresh and partly worked saves, work orders reversed and mid-job reload.
range.left_out: No guaranteed premium item or immortal loot quality after player damage; no regenerating wreck field, calving delivery, buried-person extraction, learned technology or rites. Deeps shares wreck defs, but its own salvage ecology remains its owner’s.

bars.says: A camp that exposes more warmth to the ice draws greater breach pressure, while cooling or insulating a working refuge reduces that pressure and the thermal readout explains the change.

meant.intent: Signature: the cost of comfortable stopping is a controllable thermal cause, not a fixed raid schedule; insulation preserves useful warmth indoors.
meant.source: sleeping_ice.md §4 thermal threat and §8 cold exterior; §4c.4 continuous dial; bedazzle §4 row1; delegated exterior-exposure reading reconciles those promises without treating current formula as authority.

accept: A warm refuge retains its indoor comfort after its exterior is better insulated; the readout falls and the unsaturated breach trace becomes less threatening.
An exposed campfire or opened warm room raises the thermal trend and subsequent pressure; an unpowered cold machine does not.
reject: The displayed dial changes, but naturally rolled breaches ignore it and keep following a fixed schedule.
The dial counts indoor warmth identically through an open doorway and an insulating enclosure, so a cold exterior has no benefit.
bars.lazy: The displayed dial changes, but naturally rolled breaches ignore it and keep following a fixed schedule.

range.varies: Same source cohorts at 0–100 percent duty; raw pressure below threshold, threshold neighbourhood, unsaturated and saturated; heat scale 25–600, frequency scale 0.1–4; no-source, fires, working/off pushers, powered/off consumers and warm enclosed rooms; equal indoor temperature with door open/closed, wall depth1/2, source outdoors/inside. Fixed plateau outdoors -80 to -20 C as stress envelope, not a claim about current tile census. Colony sizes 1,6,40; original and reversed heat/floor sequences; count-cap saturation explicitly removes strict increase demand. Stochastic pressure uses paired distributions, never a guarantee in a particular hour. Include capacity permanently saturated by surviving waiting shivven through cooling, reheating and reload, with no death, followed by an accounted death freeing a slot. Pressure may still respond while new openings remain suppressed at capacity.
range.left_out: No new air-temperature, sun, material-insulation or geothermal physics; a pressure sensor can use an explicit proxy. The proxy must match the cold-exterior ordering in the calibrated thermal model. Surface reconnection and thaw mechanics are off as extras.

Match source work and indoor comfort, then change only exterior protection or source duty. This distinguishes insulation from simply switching the heater off; paired cohorts distinguish monotonic pressure from a lucky silent hour.

bars.says: The camp’s first breach teaches the heat cause and gives an exact attackable countdown with time to recall an exposed worker and respond, while later breaches warn of danger without supplying an exact time or direction.

meant.intent: Needed by signature: the warning makes the hazard a decision; later uncertainty must retain a discoverable physical crack.
meant.source: sleeping_ice.md §4c.4; Source/RM_BreachCracks.cs first teaching implementation; delegated recall-and-response standard from travelling/camp experience and frozen hull rule.

accept: The first warning names warmth, points to the attackable crack and states its countdown; a recalled worker reaches shelter and the crew either breaks the crack or prepares for emergence.
A later warning says danger is near the camp without an arrow or deadline; searching the open perimeter can still find and attack the visible crack.
reject: A tutorial letter mentions heat and a timer, but the crack cannot be attacked before the exposed worker can return.
Later warnings omit the time in prose but their look target or inspect string still reveals the exact direction or countdown.
bars.lazy: A tutorial letter mentions heat and a timer, but the crack cannot be attacked before the exposed worker can return.

range.varies: FirstTaught false/true; first timer supported range2–72h with shipped default24h qualifying for the response picture, other settings accurately labelled; later timer8–16h as current tuning; workers at camp and at 30/60 cell work sites over passable ordinary ice, not trapped or incapacitated. Attack with ordinary available ranged/melee means, no debug Destroy; stop/ignore, saved before/after warning boundaries and expiry. Later discovery via manual search or installed scanner is allowed, but warning itself supplies neither location target nor exact time.
range.left_out: Exact later direction may be learned by looking, scouting or scanner; the warning does not supply it. No promise to recall an immobile pawn or one beyond the declared working radius; no extra ritual or bespoke quest tutorial.

bars.says: Built floors and the gravship hull stop emergence and under-ice passage even when completed during a breach, and a shivven redirects from inaccessible warmth toward reachable warmth it can sense.

meant.intent: Signature defence: protection holds through state changes; its success does not create a protected decoy that disables pursuit of an exposed source.
meant.source: sleeping_ice.md §4c hull rule; NightsideIce/ANSWERS_OWNER.md owner card 2026-11-10 reachable warmth answer; delegated seal transition and local-source eligibility from those rulings.

accept: Finishing a floor over a pending crack visibly seals that opening; it releases nothing at the old deadline, while a continuing warm camp can later draw a different legal crack.
A stronger protected or distant heater does not distract a shivven from a weaker reachable source in its sensing range; its actual route stays on ice around the flooring.
reject: Crack placement checks bare ice, but its expired release chooses a neighbouring floor cell or emerges through a newly built deck.
A correct ice-only planned endpoint is reported while the actual pawn repeatedly attempts a shorter floor shortcut and stalls, or a global inaccessible heater suppresses all local targets.
bars.lazy: Crack placement checks bare ice, but its expired release chooses a neighbouring floor cell or emerges through a newly built deck.

range.varies: All translated placements within supported full maps and all rotations of loaded source footprints; diagonal/cardinal bearings, rings, concave/U-shaped floors, walls/doors, narrow isthmuses, disconnected ice and map edges. Sense distance just below/at/above shipped60 and supported10–150; alive/off/destroyed/tied sources; no reachable source; heat removed mid-path; floor/roof/hull completed or removed before/at/after deadline; local legal emergence candidates zero/partial/full; reloading in each pending state; wild/downed/fighting/tame cases. Off-ice externally spawned pawns are recovery cases, never legitimate emergence evidence.
range.left_out: No promise of a crack when legal open ice is absent; no relocation of the old deadline or immunity to ranged raids. Standing on bare ice beside a heater can permit a surfaced adjacent strike without travelling through its floor. All-native-shivven mechanics are promised on SleepingIce, not arbitrary foreign biomes.

bars.says: A player can follow a moving shivven’s cracking trace and rumble while its body is concealed in the ice, then see it surface to strike reachable warmth or retaliate, with casualties left visibly accounted for.

meant.intent: Needed by signature and its harmful outcome: player-facing sign replaces the hidden body, and neither attack nor death becomes an unexplained disappearance.
meant.source: sleeping_ice.md §4c.1 rumble-tell and §4 thermal sensing; standing no-vanish ruling in CLAUDE.md; CreatureBehaviors swim contract; delegated no-larder casualty boundary.

accept: Moving cracks and a positional rumble approach an exposed heater; the animal is hidden until it surfaces and damages it.
A struck shivven surfaces and fights; a dead worker leaves a corpse and named readable account rather than vanishing below.
reject: The hediff says submerged and a fleck exists in the state dump, but it is invisible against the dirty-white ice or its sound cannot locate movement.
The animal remains visibly walking on the surface throughout its approach, or a debug seek job never completes a damaging strike.
bars.lazy: The hediff says submerged and a fleck exists in the state dump, but it is invisible against the dirty-white ice or its sound cannot locate movement.

range.varies: All approach bearings and life stages currently constructible, moving/stationary/strike/hit/downed/dead; ordinary play zoom and declared normal audio mix; empty ice, wreck clutter, aurora on/off and artificial camp light; source power toggles, edge striking, reload during submersion; 1 through proposed cap24 simultaneous wild shivven with 1–40 colonists. Distinguish admitted visitor silhouettes from concealed native shivven.
range.left_out: No custom ambient choir or native sound-sensing. Player sound reception does not grant animal hearing. No promise of the same spatial perception with game audio muted; the visible trace and inspect state must still account for hidden movement. No abduction or rescue pocket map in this version.

bars.says: Across a season a supplied camp can salvage, protect its warmth and finish ordinary work between readable breaches, with the same consequences after reloading and changing the order of its preparations.

meant.intent: Whole first version: the journey and exceptional refuge remain usable with every retained land, life and signature component active together.
meant.source: Owner-chosen experience in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md; NightsideIce/ANSWERS_OWNER.md 2026-11-10 lasting refuge answer; delegated whole-mod bar under the 2026-11-16 cleanse brief.

accept: The party crosses, chooses salvage, warms a camp, reads and stops a crack, later meets a breach, improves protection and still completes normal work; a saved continuation preserves that history.
A prepared supplied refuge keeps working as cold reduces new pressure; its animals still need supplies and its unworked finds remain preserved.
reject: Default play turns into a backlog of cracks or multiplying animals that consumes ordinary work, strips the plateau of its recoverable identity, or fills the log with repeated failures.
The combined run stays silent because a kept mechanic is disabled, timers are skipped or the sky is locked, or reloading repeats the tutorial and erases an active threat.
bars.lazy: Default play turns into a backlog of cracks or multiplying animals that consumes ordinary work, strips the plateau of its recoverable identity, or fills the log with repeated failures.

range.varies: A full 15-day RimWorld season on each supported map-size/topology regime from B1, traveller camp1–6 and prepared40-colonist refuge; all retained native content, ordinary visitors, livestock, wreckage and enabled default shared services together. Each cohort includes a save/reload near the midpoint with a pending or seeking state, then the remaining actions in another order: heat then floor versus floor then heat, salvage before warning versus after. Day100 starts also run a full season. M4 sweeps statistical event regimes; at least ordinary unforced game traces calibrate each distinct source/geometry/colony regime. Compression may omit wall-clock waiting only: every room, weather, job, needs, path, damage, hourly roll and save transition ticks normally; no delta-skipping gameplay ticks. Include capacity saturated by surviving waiting shivven for the full season, with cooling/reheating and no death, plus a matched branch with an accounted death. Both franchise-free and campaign-patched loads include shipped-default Deeps host membership and a naturally placed working descent/return, verified by C11/T28, alongside maps whose ordinary entrance rolls place none.
range.left_out: No self-sufficiency guarantee without imported food/fuel, no immunity to vanilla raids, no guarantee a random cold camp must roll a breach. For signature evidence choose matched exposed-warm cohorts with sufficient natural events, never force an opening; preserve naturally quiet cohorts as controls.

checks.what: Resolve the current composed defs, assemblies, textures, patch guard matches and bogus-name negative control; load/log/settings floor applies independently of bars. No new worker or world placement check.

Current kernel regression baseline: hourly2500 ticks offsets71/76, ease0.5, sensitivity150, threshold0.15, cooldown120000, chance=dial²/24 times scale, release2+round(6*dial), first24h/later8–16h. Tuning snapshots, not passing bars; proposed capacity24 is new provisional rule data.
Check source/room transmission and per-source eligibility tables against the approved current proxy; current HottestSource global argmax is an identified mismatch, not an acceptance oracle.
Read exact actual movement/spawn footprint cells, roof/floor/hull changes, seal status and saved deadlines, including timers crossed after stopping. End-cell-only reads are insufficient.

Read resolved inline and campaign-patched animal memberships, positive density, empty plant/fish lists, roads allowed and zero own/prefab liquid/soil/geothermal violations. Preserve the recorded cave-lemming ratio waiver; never demand a new quota.
Record per-feature toggles, resets, persistence, scope labels and combinations; two-phase off/on reads include existing pending cracks and seeking pawns, not only a fresh idle map.

Surviving waiting shivven may hold capacity permanently with no death, suppressing all further openings while their pursuit can resume after reheating; M4 must evaluate that regime as well as death-driven slot reuse.
